hostEmbeddedRuntime.note: process.versions as seen by a plugin running inside the opencode 1.18.31 binary. `bun` above is the test runner (bun test), not the plugin runtime.

install.binary: OPENCODE_BIN=<dir>/node_modules/.bin/opencode; fallback: `opencode` on PATH (Bun.which). The test fails if neither resolves, and fails if `opencode --version` != `opencode` above.
install.homeSideEffect: Installing opencode-ai@1.18.31 creates empty ~/.config/opencode, ~/.local/share/opencode/{log,repos}, ~/.cache/opencode/bin and ~/.local/state/opencode under the installing process's HOME. Run the install with HOME pointed at a throwaway directory.

verifiedWith.prefix: <session scratchpad>/host (outside the repo; not the user's HOME)

exportForms.note: All three forms load when alone. A module that exports BOTH a named plugin function and a default { id, server } has ONLY the server function invoked; the named export is ignored. src/index.ts exports the named CuratedThoughts and nothing else; the loader re-exports only that name.

findings.v0LoaderFile: $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/opencode/plugins/curated-thoughts.js containing `export { CuratedThoughts } from "file:///<payload>/lib/src/index.js";` with the payload under $XDG_DATA_HOME/curated-thoughts/opencode/ is loaded and invoked.
findings.nestedLoaderNote: plugins/nested/curated-thoughts.js is NOT loaded: only top-level files in plugins/ are scanned, matching the v0 assumption.
findings.bareNpmSpecNote: Record-only. A `plugin: ["<name>@<version>"]` entry is installed from the configured registry (HOME/.npmrc and NPM_CONFIG_REGISTRY both pointed at a local fake registry) into ~/.cache/opencode/packages/<name>@<version>/node_modules/<name> — not ~/.cache/opencode/node_modules as spec §4 says — and its named export is invoked. The host also fetched @opencode-ai/plugin from the registry.
findings.optionsNote: The ["<spec>", { ... }] tuple form (tested with a file:// URL spec) delivers the object verbatim as the plugin's second argument. Under the v0 loader file the second argument is undefined.

systemTransform.note: In `opencode run` the hook fired for the title-generation call and for each agent chat call, and EVERY call carried input.sessionID — including the title generator, which is an auxiliary call. A `if (!sessionID) return` guard therefore does not keep the block out of title generation. output.system arrived with one entry (the host's full system prompt as a single string), never already containing a previously pushed block; the host sent that entry verbatim followed by the pushed block, exactly once per request, across two processes (run, run --continue).

findings.disposeNote: dispose is called once per process when `opencode run` exits.
findings.mcpNote: With one connected and one failed local MCP server configured, no MCP event reached the `event` hook (the 1.18.31 SDK Event union's only MCP types are mcp.tools.changed and mcp.browser.open.failed; neither fired). Connection via events therefore stays 'unknown'. Pull alternative, observed: input.client.mcp.status() called from inside the system transform returned { "<name>": { status: "connected" | "failed", error? } }.

skills.note: The `skill` tool description no longer enumerates skills; it says they are listed in the system prompt, which carries <skill><name>..</name><description>..</description><location>..</location></skill> entries. The contract test asserts discovery there. The legacy singular skill/ directory is still read too; install into plural skills/.

provider.fixture: @ai-sdk/openai-compatible custom provider pointed at a local HTTP server; no credentials.
provider.minimalResponse: POST /v1/chat/completions with stream:true answered as text/event-stream: one delta chunk {role:'assistant',content}, one chunk with finish_reason 'stop', one usage chunk (choices: []), then `data: [DONE]`. That makes `opencode run` exit 0.

executedLocally: namedExportInvoked via the v0 loader file
priorSystemEntriesPreserved (checked against the request the host actually sent)
block appears exactly once in the final system prompt and in every request across run + run --continue
recorded: defaultExportInvoked, serverModuleFormInvoked, mixed-module preference, nestedLoaderLoads, bareNpmSpecLoads, mcpStatusEventTypes, client.mcp.status(), singular skill/ dir
notExecuted: Linux and Windows hosts: only darwin-x64 ran locally; the ci host job (Task 7) covers the matrix.

Tarball round trip: the payload was bundled straight into <data dir>/curated-thoughts/opencode/lib/src/index.js, not packed with tools/ct_ci_package.py and unpacked (no plugin source exists before Task 3). The loader-file delivery path itself was exercised.
A session-less transform call: none occurs in `opencode run`, so behaviour with sessionID absent was not observed.
